title: Who Should Score the Cache? Mid-Depth Layers Are the Best Judges of KV-Cache Eviction
summary: Controlled layer substitutions found that mid-depth representations preserve task-relevant information for KV-cache eviction beyond the cache-method benchmark. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
